_nota: Iconos del canal (16/11/2026). Carlos eligió el concepto «El Evangelio Radiante» (Evangelio abierto + cruz de luz) pero con la parte baja de la cruz más larga (cruz latina) y colores suaves en acuarela, coherentes con el banner (icono/banner-referencia.jpg).
comun: Delicate watercolor app icon, square 1:1, in the same soft style and pastel palette as the reference banner: wet-on-wet washes, visible cotton-paper texture, pale sky blue, peach, rose and cream, warm gold light. Soft, tender and hopeful; no hard dark colours, no navy, no black outlines. Generous empty margin around the symbol so it survives a circular crop. Absolutely no text, no letters, no people, no faces, no watermark.

variantes.libro_cruz: Centered: an open Gospel book painted in soft cream and gold watercolor, and rising from its pages a luminous cream-and-gold Latin cross. The cross must have true Latin proportions: the vertical beam clearly LONGER than the crossbar, with the lower arm about twice as long as the upper arm, standing on the book's spine. Warm golden rays fan out softly behind it. Around the cross, the clouds are a slightly deeper dusty rose and muted blue-violet watercolor so the glowing cross reads clearly even at 32 px.
variantes.cruz_amanecer: Centered: one luminous cream-and-gold Latin cross with true Latin proportions (the vertical beam clearly longer than the crossbar, the lower arm about twice the upper arm), its foot resting on a soft golden dawn horizon with a small open book glowing at its base. Soft golden rays fan out behind it. Around the cross the sky is a slightly deeper dusty rose and muted blue-violet watercolor so the glowing cross stands out clearly even at 32 px.
